title: The shape of a rank stratum
promptMarkdown: Prove the rank-$r$ codimension formula for $n\times k$ matrices using the Schur complement. Specialise to $3\times2$ matrices of rank 1. Find their tangent space at $B_0=\begin{pmatrix}1&0\\0&0\\0&0\end{pmatrix}$ and show that the full-rank locus is open.
hintLadder: Perform invertible row operations to eliminate $Q$.
At the displayed matrix the quadratic term $QA^{-1}P$ has zero derivative.
Use nonvanishing of a maximal minor for openness.
